mapper.select: SELECT id FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{now}, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE status END, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = #{error}, locked_until = #{retryAt}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
